description: This PHP source file defines the SaveEmployeeController class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for handling employee data save operations. It extends an abstract Vue controller, manages dependencies like IDGeneratorService, and prepares Vue components with properties related to employee ID and image types, as well as password requirement status depending on social media authentication.

classes.name: SaveEmployeeController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling the saving of employee information, managing Vue component preparation and dependency injection.

methods.name: getIdGeneratorService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the IDGeneratorService instance used for generating new employee IDs.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with employee data and properties before rendering, including employee ID, allowed image types, and password requirement status.
